# Spin Button

Edit a numeric draft directly or change it with increment controls.

## Examples

### Integer

Accept whole-number drafts and expose increment and decrement controls.

<ComponentExample component="spin-button" scenario="integer" title="Integer" description="Accept whole-number drafts and expose increment and decrement controls." :index="0" />

### Input recovery

Type a quantity directly; leaving an invalid edit restores the last accepted value.

<ComponentExample component="spin-button" scenario="invalid-draft" title="Input recovery" description="Type a quantity directly; leaving an invalid edit restores the last accepted value." :index="1" />

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow Right</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Up</kbd> | Increase the value by one step. |
| <kbd>Arrow Left</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Down</kbd> | Decrease the value by one step. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | Move to the minimum or maximum value. |
| <kbd>Page Up</kbd> / <kbd>Page Down</kbd> | Change the value by the configured page step when supported. |

## Accessibility

The input exposes spinbutton value metadata while increment and decrement remain named native controls.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/spinbutton/) for the host accessibility contract.
